panels.title: Platform health
panels.description: Average of the three service scores. docs/health-score.md is the opinion behind it.

panels.title: Active critical alerts
panels.description: Only YOUR rules (they carry a service label). kube-prometheus-stack's kind false positives (scheduler/controller-manager/proxy 'down') are excluded here — and silenced in Alertmanager — but ALERTS in Prometheus would still count them.

panels.title: Deploys & rollbacks (24h)
panels.description: Next to the alert count on purpose: 'it broke right after a deploy' is the most common diagnosis in the business.

panels.title: activation — card activation at the till
Error budget left (30d)
panels.description: Negative = over budget.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Baseline ~3%: 1% email + activation's 2%.

panels.title: p95 activate step
panels.description: If THIS is red and activation's own p95 is red, it's activation. If this is red and activation is green, it's the network between them.

panels.title: Minutes since last success
panels.description: Expected every 5. Red at 15 = SettlementStale.

panels.title: Records last run
panels.description: ZERO with a fresh run = the silent failure.

panels.title: Last run status
panels.description: 1 = success, 0 = failure. Distinguishes 'did not run' from 'ran and failed'.

panels.title: Open incidents
panels.description: incidents_open from the bot. Anything above 0 means a bridge should be running. No data = the bot is down (IncidentBotDown will fire).

panels.title: Incidents (24h)
panels.description: increase(incidents_created_total[24h]). A core operational KPI — teams are judged on its trend. increase() survives bot restarts (counter resets).

panels.title: Last incident duration
panels.description: incident_last_duration_minutes — how long the most recent ticket stayed open. Day 10's KPI table tracks the trend.

panels.title: Webhooks (1h)
panels.description: Alertmanager -> bot deliveries in the last hour, firing vs resolved. Zero for hours while alerts fire = routing is broken.

panels.title: Bot scraped
panels.description: up{job="incident-bot"}. Monitor the monitor.

panels.title: Auto actions (24h)
panels.description: Tier 1: ran without asking. Every one is a note on a ticket.

panels.title: Awaiting approval
panels.description: Tier 2 proposals with a live token. Anything above 0 is a human's decision waiting.

panels.title: Approved (24h)
panels.description: Tier 2 actions a human said yes to, and that succeeded.

panels.title: Failed / skipped (24h)
panels.description: Actions that failed, or were skipped by the cooldown. An automation that fails silently is the settlement job all over again.

panels.title: Human required (24h)
panels.description: Tier 3: no signature matched — the remediator wrote 'human required' and did nothing else.

panels.title: Remediator scraped
panels.description: 1 = Prometheus is scraping the remediator. 0 = RemediatorDown will fire.

panels.title: KPIs (Day 18) — the queryable four of seven; MTTD, MTTR, precision and deploys come from tools/kpis.py --summary and the daily report
Error budget left — availability (30d)
panels.description: KPI 5. 99.5 % SLO, 0.5 % budget. Below 50 % is a RISK line in the daily report.

panels.title: Error budget left — latency (30d)
panels.description: KPI 5. 99 % under 300 ms, 1 % budget (Day 18: the latency SLO finally has an alert too).

panels.title: Incidents opened (7d) by service
panels.description: KPI 3. The bot's counter, by service (Day 18 build). increase() survives restarts.

panels.title: Remediated auto/approved (7d)
panels.description: KPI 4. Share of incidents the platform fixed itself or on one human yes. Tier 3 (fraud) can never count — that is the policy, not a gap.

panels.title: Alerts firing now (all)
panels.description: After the Day 18 audit this should be 0 on a quiet day. Every one that is not ours has a verdict in docs/alert-audit.md.

panels.title: Platform restarts (24h)
panels.description: PlatformPodRestarting's input. Day 14 found 70+112 of these a week late; Day 17 found 47.
